title: Please Me! A Sexuality Podcast
author: Eve Hall
description: Welcome to Please Me! Podcast with EveWhere Sexuality, Self Improvement, and Education Take Center Stage Please Me! is a bold, sex-positive, body-positive podcast exploring sexuality, sexual health, intimacy, and empowerment—without shame or taboos. Hosted by Eve Hall, a licensed Physical Therapist specializing in pelvic floor therapy and sexual wellness, this show is your no-BS guide to reclaiming desire, closing the orgasm gap, and embracing radical self-love and authentic sexuality. Through candid conversations, expert interviews, and unfiltered real talk, Please Me! explores what it truly means to thrive erotically, emotionally, and physically. Whether you’re navigating hormones, healing from trauma, enhancing sexual confidence, or curious about kink, this podcast is for you. Topics include: • Sexual health and holistic wellness • Orgasm equality and closing the orgasm gap • Women’s health and men’s sexual wellness • LGBTQ+ and queer sexuality • Body image, self-love, and sex positivity • Intersectional feminism and reproductive rights • Perimenopause, menopause, libido, and hormone balance • Erectile dysfunction and non-surgical male enhancement (pumps, extenders, smart rings) • Kink, BDSM, role play, and erotic communication • Consent, boundaries, and modern dating culture • Sexual dysfunction and holistic care solutions • Pelvic floor therapy, intimacy, and pleasure education No shame. No censorship. Just conversations to help you reclaim sexual agency, explore desires
